name: claudesidian
description: Claude Code + Obsidian Starter Kit - AI-powered second brain

scripts.setup: pnpm install && echo '✅ Setup complete! Configure GEMINI_API_KEY for vision features'
scripts.attachments:list: ATTACHMENTS=$(node .scripts/vault-config.js attachments) && ORGANIZED=$(node .scripts/vault-config.js attachmentsOrganized) && ls -1 "$ATTACHMENTS/" | grep -v "$(basename "$ORGANIZED")" | head -20
scripts.attachments:count: ATTACHMENTS=$(node .scripts/vault-config.js attachments) && ORGANIZED=$(node .scripts/vault-config.js attachmentsOrganized) && ls -1 "$ATTACHMENTS/" | grep -v "$(basename "$ORGANIZED")" | wc -l
scripts.attachments:sizes: find "$(node .scripts/vault-config.js attachments)" -type f -exec du -h {} + | sort -rh | head -20
scripts.attachments:orphans: for file in "$(node .scripts/vault-config.js attachments)"/*; do basename "$file" | xargs -I {} sh -c 'grep -r "{}" . --include="*.md" > /dev/null || echo "{}"'; done
scripts.skills:validate: for d in .agents/skills/*/; do uv run --with pyyaml python .agents/skills/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py "$d" || exit 1; done && echo '✅ All skills valid'
